newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine's Kuchma reminds Yeltsin of promised visit.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine's Kuchma reminds Yeltsin of promised visit.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma wished Russian President Boris Yeltsin a quick recovery from his heart surgery on Tuesday -- and reminded him of a promise to make Kiev his first port of call once he felt better.

"I want to wish you with all my heart, on behalf of all the Ukrainian people, and from me personally, the quickest of recoveries," Kuchma's press office quoted him as saying in a telegram to the Russian leader.
"I believe that the planned meeting in Kiev will give a new boost to Russian-Ukrainian relations and will take place in the very near future," he added.
Yeltsin promised Kuchma when they met in Moscow on October 24 that he would visit Kiev to sign a long-awaited friendship treaty once he had recovered from surgery.
Yeltsin, who had a multiple heart bypass operation on Tuesday, had postponed six trips to Kiev in 20 months.
But the two men appear to have narrowed their differences over the Black Sea Fleet -- based on Ukraine's Crimean peninsula.
